GLib 0.18.5 with the exact two-line safety fix from gtk-rs/gtk-rs-core PR #1343, merge 05dff0ee696f9bcd8617cd48c4b812d046d440cb. This changes VariantStrIter::impl_get to pass a mutable out-pointer. It resolves the code defect described by RUSTSEC-2024-0429 without changing the GTK 0.18 ABI. The package version is retained for dependency compatibility, so cargo-audit still reports the version-based informational warning. Original source and license notices are retained. Linux native tests require the system GTK development libraries; Windows does not compile GLib.
